$about: Site-level configuration. Everything the templates need that is not registry data lives here. Adding a new zone needs NO edit in this file unless you want custom copy: zones come from the registry's _meta.json, and unknown zones fall back to the "default" branding with {zone} substituted. Use {zone} in any zone string to have it replaced with the zone name.

single.intro: Every founder needs a landing page. Yours can live at freelancer.{zone} without the eight-hundred-dollar domain, the pitch deck, or the company itself. Point it at whatever you are shipping this weekend.

multi.intro: Free subdomains across several zones, run in the open. Pick a zone below, check that the name is free, then claim it with a pull request. Everything is plain JSON, DNSControl and GitHub Actions.

default.tagline: Free *.{zone} subdomains, claimed with a pull request.
default.intro: Free *.{zone} subdomains for the thing you are about to ship, the thing you already shipped, and the landing page for the thing you have not started yet.

is-a.ceo.tagline: The zone where the title comes free and the company is optional.
